hypothesis: HAL review at helen.py:63 receives full conversation history as context; HAL only needs the proposal dict to evaluate determinism/safety. Stripping history from HAL's context yields 80-94% token savings per review call.
summary: helen.py:63 calls hal.review(proposal, context) where context = [system_msg] + full_history (O(history) tokens). hal.review() passes context unchanged to adapter.generate() — the history is never inspected by HAL logic, only forwarded to the LLM. For a 20-turn session this adds ~1741 tokens to every HAL call (system+history) for zero benefit. Proposed fix: pass context=[] to hal.review() at both call sites (helen.py:63 and helen.py:170).

helen_os_scaffold/helen_os/hal.py:31 — adapter.generate(prompt, context) — context forwarded unchanged

helen_os_scaffold/helen_os/helen.py:169-170 — second call site: context=[system_msg_only], hal.review(proposal, context)
Measured: 20-turn session → 1951t HAL input vs 210t lean (89% waste)
proposed_tweak: At helen.py:63 change to hal.review({...}, []). At helen.py:170 change to hal.review(proposal, []). No change to hal.py or adapters.py. Two one-line edits.
metric: Stub test: mock adapter captures context arg in hal.review(); assert len(context_passed) == 0; run existing helen_os_scaffold/tests/ suite to confirm no regression.
rule: keep if HAL verdict distribution unchanged in smoke test (PASS/WARN/BLOCK rates stable) and no test regression; reject if any downstream system depends on HAL receiving history
